short.q: Translate into English: man haadhaa?
short.answer: Who is this? (a boy or man)
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi yadii
short.answer: This is my hand.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain how a family celebration you know helps people to live together in peace. (3 marks)
short.answer: People meet, share food and joy, sing and talk together, and learn to respect one another.
short.working: 1 mark for meeting, 1 mark for sharing, 1 mark for respect.

short.q: Write three classroom instructions in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example qif (stand up), ijlis (sit down), iftahi l-baab (open the door).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

short.q: Arrange these sentences into a good paragraph and give a reason: uhibbu baytii / haadhaa baytii / baytii kabiir. (3 marks)
short.answer: haadhaa baytii. baytii kabiir. uhibbu baytii. The topic comes first, then a detail, then the feeling at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for the first sentence, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Translate into English: alʿabu yawma s-sabt
short.answer: I play on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt
short.answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why we should show respect when we greet people of a different gender or culture. (3 marks)
short.answer: Greeting customs can differ. Using polite words and a smile shows respect. Respect helps boys and girls, men and women to be treated equally and to live peacefully.
short.working: 1 mark for customs differ, 1 mark for polite words, 1 mark for equality or peace.

short.q: Write four Arabic celebration words in English letters with their meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), kaʿka (cake).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam
short.answer: There are seven days in a week.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe the steps of making a class picture book on family celebrations. (4 marks)
short.answer: Collect or draw pictures of celebration things; put one on each page; write an Arabic word or sentence with the meaning; make a cover with a title.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Translate into English: uhibbu l-mawza
short.answer: I like bananas.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three questions you could ask when you give peer feedback on a friend's fluency. (3 marks)
short.answer: Were the words clear? Was the speed steady? Did the voice fall for statements and rise for questions?
short.working: 1 mark for each suitable question.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa jismii
short.answer: This is my body.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks)
short.answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step.

short.q: Translate into English: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba
short.answer: The pen is in the bag.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba
short.answer: I drink milk.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write one Arabic sentence about your body in sounds and translate it. (2 marks)
short.answer: For example aktubu bi-yadii. I write with my hand.
short.working: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks)
short.answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
short.working: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.

short.q: Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Explain why we celebrate special occasions and how pictures help us to understand a text. (3 marks)
short.answer: Celebrations bring people together and give joy. Pictures show what a text is about and act as clues to new words.
short.working: 1 mark for celebrations and 2 marks for pictures as clues.

short.q: Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks)
short.answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
short.working: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

short.q: Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla
short.answer: The friends are at the party.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa tilmiidha
short.answer: I am a pupil (girl).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii and atakallamu bi-famii. (2 marks)
short.answer: I see with my eye. I speak with my mouth.
short.working: 1 mark for each translation.

short.q: Translate into English: nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a
short.answer: We look after the environment.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: lii yadaani
short.answer: I have two hands.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-jawwu mumtir
short.answer: The weather is rainy.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain what pace is and describe a good pace for reading aloud. (3 marks)
short.answer: Pace is the speed of reading. A good pace is steady, not too fast so that listeners understand, and not so slow that the sentence sounds broken.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 2 marks for the description.

short.q: Give the steps for reading a new Arabic word. (3 marks)
short.answer: Look at each letter and its mark; read each syllable; blend the syllables and check that the word makes sense.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Translate into English: asmaʿu bi-udhunii
short.answer: I hear with my ear.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give two ways of taking care of your body. (2 marks)
short.answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible way.

short.q: Translate into English: al-baabu kabiir
short.answer: The door is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why vocabulary building helps you to learn Arabic. (3 marks)
short.answer: The more words you know, the more you can understand, say and write. Grouping words by theme helps you to remember them.
short.working: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for speaking or writing and 1 mark for remembering.

short.q: Translate into English: ar-riihu qawiyya
short.answer: The wind is strong.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii baytii matbakh
short.answer: In my house there is a kitchen.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe three ways to work out the meaning of an unfamiliar word. (3 marks)
short.answer: Use the sentence around the word; use a picture or a word you know; look it up in a dictionary or ask.
short.working: 1 mark for each way.

short.q: Translate into English: uhibbu baytii
short.answer: I like my house.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks)
short.answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
short.answer: I visit my grandmother on Friday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain how the same Arabic word can look different but keep its meaning. (2 marks)
short.answer: In different writing styles the letter shapes change a little, but the letters, sounds and meaning stay the same.
short.working: 1 mark for shapes change and 1 mark for meaning stays the same.

short.q: Translate into English: adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn
short.answer: I go to school on Monday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain why correct spelling is important in Arabic. (2 marks)
short.answer: A missing letter or a wrong dot can change the word, so the reader may not understand.
short.working: 1 mark for a change in the word and 1 mark for understanding.

short.q: Explain why untidy handwriting can be a problem in Arabic. (2 marks)
short.answer: Letters that differ only by dots may look the same, so the reader may read the wrong word.
short.working: 1 mark for dots and 1 mark for the wrong reading.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa raʾsii
short.answer: This is my head.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila
short.answer: In the kitchen there is a table.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Read the sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ and write its meaning. (2 marks)
short.answer: ismii Ahmad. My name is Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for reading and 1 mark for meaning.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds a question and an answer about bananas and give the meaning. (4 marks)
short.answer: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? naʿam, uhibbu l-mawz. Do you like bananas? Yes, I like bananas.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Explain why writing the dots correctly is important. Give one example of two letters that differ only by dots. (3 marks)
short.answer: A wrong dot changes the letter and the word. For example ف has one dot above and ق has two dots above.
short.working: 1 mark for changes the letter, 1 mark for changes the word, 1 mark for a correct example.

short.q: Give three items from a peer review checklist for reading aloud. (3 marks)
short.answer: Every word read correctly; steady pace; voice rises for questions; pauses at commas; voice shows feeling.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid item.

short.q: Give two ways of keeping household items safe. (2 marks)
short.answer: Keep the key in a safe place such as the cupboard; keep knives out of reach of small children; keep lamps away from water.
short.working: 1 mark for each safe way.

short.q: Translate into English: jaddatii tuhibbunii
short.answer: My grandmother loves me.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla. (2 marks)
short.answer: The friends are at the party.
short.working: 1 mark for 'the friends' and 1 mark for 'at the party'.

short.q: Write the Arabic sounds and meanings of four position words. (4 marks)
short.answer: fii (in), ʿalaa (on), taHta (under), fawqa (above).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Explain why a speaker should practise before speaking to an audience. (2 marks)
short.answer: Practice helps the speaker to remember words, pronounce them correctly and feel less nervous.
short.working: 1 mark for remembering or pronouncing and 1 mark for confidence.

short.q: Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii
short.answer: I write with my hand.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
short.answer: Do you like bananas?
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three rules for taking turns in a conversation. (3 marks)
short.answer: Listen until the speaker finishes; do not speak at the same time; use polite words to interrupt; give others a chance.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid rule.

short.q: Explain why it is important to know the days of the week. (2 marks)
short.answer: Days help us to plan what to do and to use time well, for example school, homework and rest.
short.working: 1 mark for planning and 1 mark for good use of time.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka
short.answer: On the table there is a cake.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt. (2 marks)
short.answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
short.working: 1 mark for 'I help my mother' and 1 mark for 'on Saturday'.

short.q: Translate into English: ashummu bi-anfii
short.answer: I smell with my nose.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe how a group can stage a poem at an interclass festival. (4 marks)
short.answer: Choose a group; share the lines and actions; stand facing the audience; say the poem together with actions; bow at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu
short.answer: My mother cooks.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-jawwu haarr
short.answer: The weather is hot.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write three foods and two drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example khubz (bread), samak (fish), mawz (bananas), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Describe two things you can do to pronounce the days of the week correctly. (2 marks)
short.answer: Listen to the teacher and repeat; say the days in a chain; practise the sounds th and kh slowly.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid method.

short.q: Translate into English: al-jawwu baarid
short.answer: The weather is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks)
short.answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
short.working: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

short.q: Introduce yourself in Arabic (English letters are fine) with your name, that you are a pupil and that you are from Kenya, then give the English meaning. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example: ismii Wanjiku. anaa tilmiidha. anaa min Kiiniya. My name is Wanjiku. I am a pupil. I am from Kenya.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-ʿasiiru baarid
short.answer: The juice is cold.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe three steps of making a weather poster. (3 marks)
short.answer: Draw and colour the sun, clouds, rain and wind; write the Arabic word under each; add a sentence and a title and display it.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya
short.answer: I am from Kenya.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-jawwu ghaa'im
short.answer: The weather is cloudy.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: shukran li-istimaaʿikum
short.answer: Thank you for listening.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks)
short.answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct match.

short.q: Translate into English: akhii Sagiir
short.answer: My brother is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks)
short.answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
short.working: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Say what the words abii yaʿmalu and ummii tatbukhu mean, and name one thing each parent does. (4 marks)
short.answer: abii yaʿmalu: My father works. ummii tatbukhu: My mother cooks.
short.working: 1 mark for each translation and 1 mark for each role named.

short.q: Explain why dots are important in Arabic letters. Give an example. (3 marks)
short.answer: Some letters have the same body shape and differ only by their dots. For example baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and thaa has three dots above.
short.working: 1 mark for same shape, 1 mark for dots make the difference and 1 mark for a correct example.

short.q: Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks)
short.answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
short.working: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Write a three-sentence paragraph about your room in Arabic sounds and give the meaning. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example: haadhihi ghurfatii. fii l-ghurfati sariir. uhibbu ghurfatii. This is my room. In the room there is a bed. I like my room.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence, 1 mark for a beginning-middle-end order and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Read the sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي and give its meaning. Say which family word it contains. (3 marks)
short.answer: haadhihi ummii. This is my mother. It contains umm (mother).
short.working: 1 mark for reading, 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for the family word.

short.q: List four theme words about the home in Arabic (English letters), with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table), kursii (chair).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi shams
short.answer: This is the sun.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: yadii Sagiira
short.answer: My hand is small.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Name three Arabic writing styles and state one use of one of them. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example Naskh, Ruqʿah and Kufic. Naskh is used in printed books.
short.working: 1 mark for each style named (up to 2) and 1 mark for a correct use.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii. (2 marks)
short.answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
short.working: 1 mark for each part.

short.q: Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam
short.answer: My mother cooks the food.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain how the voice should sound in a statement and in a question. (2 marks)
short.answer: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct description.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid
short.answer: Happy birthday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Put the words in order and translate: كَبِيرٌ / بَيْتِي. (2 marks)
short.answer: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ. My house is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Say why food is important for human life and name two foods grown in Kenya. (3 marks)
short.answer: Food gives energy to grow, learn and stay healthy. Examples are maize and bananas.
short.working: 1 mark for the importance and 1 mark each for two foods.

short.q: Explain the difference between kayfa haaluka? and kayfa haaluki? (2 marks)
short.answer: kayfa haaluka? is said to a boy or man. kayfa haaluki? is said to a girl or woman. Both mean 'How are you?'.
short.working: 1 mark for the boy and girl endings and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write five foods or drinks in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), dhura (maize), lahm (meat), samak (fish).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

short.q: Explain why neat and legible writing matters when a poem is displayed. (3 marks)
short.answer: Readers can read it easily, the dots and marks show the right words, and neat work shows care and pride.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i
short.answer: And the rain is from the sky.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ayna l-kitaab?
short.answer: Where is the book?
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra
short.answer: The sun is hot.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks)
short.answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.
